name: Unciv
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The turn server for Unciv's multiplayer, where players' games are kept between turns. Installs the server of any Unciv release, checked against GitHub's checksum.
startup: a=-no-auth; c=-no-chat; i=-no-Identify; [ "{{AUTH}}" = 1 ] && a=-auth; [ "{{CHAT}}" = 1 ] && c=-chat; [ "{{IDENTIFY}}" = 1 ] && i=-Identify; exec java -Xms64M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -Dlogback.configurationFile=logback.xml -jar UncivServer.jar -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -folder=MultiplayerFiles "$a" "$c" "$i"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unciv multiplayer server. Downloads UncivServer.jar of the chosen Unciv
# release from its GitHub releases, checked against GitHub's checksum. The
# games in MultiplayerFiles/, server.auth (players' passwords) and
# logback.xml are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=yairm210/Unciv
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "${VERSION:-latest}" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "Unciv has no release ${VERSION:-latest}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 4.19.0."
sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 == "UncivServer.jar" { print $2 }')
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Unciv $tag has no server download. Choose another version."

if [ -f UncivServer.jar ] && [ "$(sha256sum UncivServer.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "The Unciv $tag server is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading the Unciv $tag server"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" UncivServer.jar UncivServer.jar ||
        fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
fi

mkdir -p MultiplayerFiles
# Unciv logs every network detail without a logging setup: keep it to the
# server's own messages. Edit logback.xml to log more.
if [ ! -f logback.xml ]; then
    cat > logback.xml <<'XML'
<configuration>
  <appender name="console" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
    <encoder><pattern>%d{HH:mm:ss} %-5level %msg%n</pattern></encoder>
  </appender>
  <root level="WARN"><appender-ref ref="console"/></root>
  <logger name="io.ktor.server.Application" level="INFO"/>
</configuration>
XML
fi
echo "Installed the Unciv $tag server."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Unciv release whose server to install, such as 4.19.0, or latest for the newest. Use the version your players run, then reinstall the server.

variables.name: Passwords
variables.description: Let each player protect their games with a password, so nobody else can play their turns.

variables.name: Chat
variables.description: Let players chat in their games through the server.

variables.name: Log addresses
variables.description: Show the address of each player in the console when they load or save a game.
